title: IBM's new Granite 4.2 models ride the wave of interest in local LLMs
summary: IBM has rolled out the newest models in its family of open-weight large language models designed to be downloaded and self-hosted. IBM’s Granite family of models rarely grabs headlines for being the fastest or most aggressively innovative.
